# Source

LVGL v9.6.0, commit `80ca777e37a2b176770726a02e07a6fb79ef0b39`, https://github.com/lvgl/lvgl, MIT license (`LICENCE.txt`). Vendored 2026-10-06 with `demos/`, `examples/`, `docs/`, `tests/` and the `drivers/` and `libs/` sources removed to save disk; nothing else changed in this folder. Three small size patches (12 added lines in three files) are applied by the build and kept as `mspm0g3507/lvgl-g3507/size-patch.diff`. Moved here from `mspm0g3507/lvgl-g3507/lvgl/` on 2026-10-07 so every board builds the same copy.
